status: whole-PHP mathematical architecture before realization; no new runtime behavior or speed claim
scope: For every PHP program and configuration, not a benchmark-distribution or PHPStan-region model
semantic_claim: proof obligation for full PHP, not a certification that the present baseline supports full PHP
observable_equivalence: all finite execution prefixes, coupled admissible external responses, exact values/aliases/effects/logical frames/lifetime/resume; time/random/I/O remain real effects
instruction_objective: minimize the whole executed cost function I_A(program,state,configuration,world), including source/startup/compile/link/plan/guards/allocations/ownership/callbacks/fallback/teardown
architecture_names: immutable declaration/type/source descriptors with separate mutable state
ordered type DAG and pure predicate pair reuse
separate source load, compile, link and execute
common effect/ownership SSA IR with checked executor and both native lowerings
required_semantic_families: variables, globals, statics, aliases and closures
classes, objects, interfaces, traits, enums, hooks and lazy state
type validity, matching, coercion, variance and reflection
all control flow, diagnostics, handlers, exceptions and shutdown
ownership, memory accounting, GC, weak and resources
all standard-library and extension leaf contracts

opcode_inventory.coverage_meaning: contract-family classification only; no per-opcode correctness, new PHP support or native coverage claim

baseline_param_type_hint_variants.coverage_meaning: existing representation inventory, not a complete PHP type-surface proof

semantic_gaps.source_forms_without_opcode: covered by required contracts, not automatically proved by enum inventory
semantic_gaps.missing_native_handler: explicit implementation/proof obligation, never assumed canonical fallback
semantic_gaps.optional_generics: separate RPHP feature contracts, not reference PHP

online_selection.assumptions: stable known C>0, delta=b-h>0; guard/profiling costs included; no unaccounted mutation/recompilation/side exit
online_selection.claim: at most 2x offline excess cost under these assumptions, not measured speedup or 100x

phpstan_witness.role: one retained same-input acceptance witness; numeric thresholds never engine admission conditions

type_cost_accounting.formula: I_DAG(visited type nodes, visited type edges) + sum(I_nominal(actual query_i))
nominal_query_cost_includes: closure construction or reconstruction after invalidation or eviction
type_cost_accounting.shared_preparation_counted: exactly once at the query that performs it
type_cost_accounting.constant_lookup_condition: proved cache hit with fixed-size resolved-ID key
type_cost_accounting.prices: unknown, never inferred from the query count

source_cost_accounting.formula: sum(I_load(actual load events)) + sum(I_artifact(actual cache events)) + sum(I_translate(actual translation events)) + sum(I_link_execute_effect(required events))
source_cost_accounting.unique_translation_count_condition: proved retention of all reused artifacts throughout the measured run within the memory budget
source_cost_accounting.double_count_rule: each actual instruction belongs to one term; do not add an inclusive miss price to the same translation price
